control_load.schema: ControlSet { version, description?, controls: ControlItem[] }; ControlItem { id, framework, pattern, intent, collectors[], note?, tagProvenance? }

evidence_retrieval.dispatch: src/tools/executor.ts executeCollector from assessControl (src/agent/agent.ts) or DETERMINISTIC_CHECKS
evidence_retrieval.mltrack_card: mltrack card export writes evidence: [] ; mlassure does not read it

output_format.stdout: human table in runLive (STATUS_ICON); scaffold listing without --live
output_format.bundle: --bundle <dir> writeEvidenceBundle: report.json, evidence/<uuid>.json, optional oscal.json/narrative.md, manifest.json (BUNDLE_FORMAT_VERSION=1)
output_format.report_json_schema: AssessmentReport { targetName, endpointName, controlSetVersion, runAt, results: ControlResult[] }

three_way_verdict.notes: Judgment.status is 5-valued: satisfied | partially-satisfied | not-satisfied | not-applicable | insufficient-evidence (src/types.ts JUDGMENT_STATUSES). OSCAL toObjectiveState maps only satisfied to OSCAL satisfied; all others to not-satisfied. Closest native analog of undetermined is insufficient-evidence. Do not change the enum for the study.

gap_list: exact control text (ControlItem.intent) not copied onto ControlResult / report.json
LLM model name/version not written anywhere (alias local to AnthropicProvider; response.model discarded)
temperature not logged and not CLI-settable; agent never passes it so every run is 0.1
no --report/JSONL flag; machine-readable output only if operator passes --oscal and/or --bundle
--oscal omits uncited retrieved evidence and control intent; projects verdict to binary
stdout-only --live runs leave no file log
